inputs.prompt: A concept artist sketchbook page of prop exploration for a dark fantasy video game: twelve rough concept sketches of the work station of a towering alien weapon smith, a cold forge and a surgeon bench where weapons go in and come out changed, laid out in a grid of four columns and three rows on white paper, each sketch numbered with a big hand written number from 1 to 12. Loose confident pencil lines with grey marker shading and a quick wash of dark gunmetal, orange glyph light, and three accent glows: purple, electric blue and gold. Every sketch shows the whole object in a three quarter view standing on bare sand, each a genuinely different idea, all made by one alien civilisation from pearly opalescent scaled shell, plum cloth printed with a starfield, rose gold trims and dark gunmetal with glowing orange glyph seams. Every one shows three lit parts for his three powers: a purple pull like a small black hole, a blue portal, and gold frozen time like a clock. No anvil, no hammer, no fire. The twelve ideas: 1 an operating slab where a weapon lies clamped, three jointed arms above it each ending in a purple, a blue and a gold lens. 2 a standing ring gate a weapon is pushed through, its three segments glowing purple, blue and gold. 3 a captive black hole floating over a rose gold cradle, weapons held into it with long tongs. 4 three stacked basins of light, purple, blue and gold, that a blade is dipped through in turn. 5 a turntable with three stations around it, a weapon riding from one to the next. 6 a tall crucible tower with a purple window, a blue portal mouth at its foot and a gold clock dial on top. 7 an hourglass machine with gold sand falling and a weapon hanging still in its waist. 8 a giant kneeling metal hand that holds a weapon in its palm while three rings orbit it. 9 a loom of light threads strung between two pylons, a weapon woven through the threads. 10 a weapon pinned open like a specimen on a dark board, three glowing scalpels hovering over it. 11 a vertical press with two heavy glyph plates and three orbs above. 12 a dark altar with a swirling vortex in its top, a blue door in its side and a gold clock face on its front. Short hand written notes and arrows beside some sketches. Clean white paper, no frame, no other text.
